# large-datasets-sources

One descriptor per corpus. TWO today and the pair is deliberately far apart, because one example is a special case with an interface drawn round it: WHO IRIS (items stand alone; three identifier systems; paged REST) and Lean mathlib (declarations need their import closure; one identifier system; a local module graph). The `subsetIsSelfContained: false` row exists only because the second was written.
